title: General perturbations element sets of Earth satellites (two-line elements), by group: space stations, GNSS constellations, weather and bright satellites
provider: CelesTrak (T. S. Kelso), from the 18th and 19th Space Defense Squadrons' public catalogue

stations.description: Space stations and the vehicles visiting them (about 30)

visual.description: The hundred or so brightest satellites

format: Three-line element sets: a name line, then lines 1 and 2 of the two-line element format (NORAD, Spacetrack Report No. 3; CelesTrak, 'Frequently Asked Questions: Two-Line Element Set Format'), mean elements in the TEME frame for the SGP4/SDP4 model, the epoch in UTC. Read by the navigation bridge's C++ (orbits/tle.hpp).
coverage: The satellites of the group at the retrieval; elements are renewed several times a day, and their accuracy decays with their age (a kilometre or more after a few days for low orbits).
licence: Distributed freely by CelesTrak; CelesTrak asks that a group be fetched no more often than its data change (about every two hours) and that CelesTrak be credited.
citation: Kelso, T. S. CelesTrak, https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/ (retrieved on the date of retrieval.json). Vallado, D. A., Crawford, P., Hujsak, R. and Kelso, T. S. (2006), Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3, AIAA 2006-6753.
